title: Skali installer node configuration
description: Per-host install configuration consumed by skali cluster install --config.

capabilities.description: Designated workload capabilities for this node.

cluster.description: Cluster name created by the first server. Defaults to production.

join.description: Join an existing cluster instead of creating one.

server.description: Optional alternate URL of an existing K3s server; current Skali tokens supply a default.

tokenFile.description: Path to a file holding the join token.

network.description: How this host is addressed: cluster address, public addresses, and certificate names.

clusterIP.description: Address other cluster nodes reach this node through. Defaults to the address of the default route.

coordinatorBind.description: Scopes the enrollment coordinator listens on: cluster, public, or both. Defaults to cluster.

extraSANs.description: Additional names or addresses to place in the Kubernetes API server certificate, such as a load balancer or a DNS name used in kubeconfigs.

publicIPs.description: Addresses reachable from outside the cluster network. Floating or NAT-mapped addresses may be declared here without being assigned to the host.

role.description: K3s role: server or agent. Current join tokens supply it for joining nodes.

vm.description: macOS only: the Lima VM hosting this node.

cpus.description: CPU cores allocated to the VM. Defaults to all host cores minus one.

disk.description: VM disk size such as 100GiB. Defaults to 100GiB.

memory.description: VM memory such as 12GiB. Defaults to host memory minus 4GiB.

name.description: Lima instance name. Defaults to skali.

network.description: VM network mode: bridged, shared, or user-v2. Defaults to bridged.
